right-pagecomments-write: User right label: can write page comments.
right-pagecomments-moderate: User right label: can moderate page comments.
pagecomments-ui-title: Sidebar title for page comments panel.
pagecomments-ui-close: Label for button that hides the off-canvas comments panel.
pagecomments-ui-edit: Label for action that edits a comment inside a thread.
pagecomments-ui-delete: Label for action that deletes a single comment inside a thread.
pagecomments-ui-more-actions: Tooltip text for the three-dots button opening comment actions menu.
pagecomments-ui-show-thread: Label for action that expands a collapsed thread in panel.
pagecomments-ui-hide-thread: Label for action that collapses an expanded thread in panel.
pagecomments-ui-overlap-selection: Error text shown when user selects text that overlaps an existing comment range.
pagecomments-ui-select-hint: Hint in empty state: user should select article text to create a comment.
pagecomments-ui-selected-text: Label displayed above preview of the text selection that anchors a thread.
